text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Having grown stronger through her training 
and confirmed she was in peak condition to 
race, Biko Pegasus was finally ready to 
enter the Classic Year.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Biko Pegasus's generation included 
formidable powerhouses like Hishi Amazon 
and Narita Brian.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
However, Biko Pegasus runs the sprint 
route. She likely wouldn't ever run 
against Narita Brian, who was expected to 
pursue the Classic Triple Crown.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Biko Pegasus's rival—or rather, the final 
boss—was Sakura Bakushin O, who boasted 
unmatched dominance, especially at 1200 
meters.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
To one day run in a GⅠ alongside her, she 
decided to first take on the GⅡ New 
Zealand Trophy.
